title: Influence as a sum of squared Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The influence of $f$ at coordinate $i$ is the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients over all subsets containing $i$: $\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\},\ i\in S}\widehat f(S)^2$.
